items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And he was in charge of the music department. So, he was the director of the band.

ctx.x: And, see, that's Guieu (phon Guieu) Taylor, you may have heard of Guieu Taylor. He was a good violin player who worked with Basie at the Avalon Theatre. And he was in charge of the music department. So, he was the director of the band. Naturally, we had a pretty good size-- we had about a 18-piece marching band, you know. And we played for the assembly every morning, in fact, about eight of us-- The Lord's Prayer and a couple of tunes, 'Indian Dawn,' and we played 'Hungarian Rhapsody,' things like that.
Yeah. Well, I mean this was all very good for you.
